body.en: “History” is a heading on the crawled page, used here only as the section name. It does not create a measurement. Sizes φ60, φ70 and φ80. Each size is listed as white or black, and as upper or lower. This note is φ70 only. Unit: piece. The ball's material grade and service life are missing fields. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A swing-cylinder seal at φ70 is a set on another page. Ordering the ball does not include that seal. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: “历史”是抓到的那一页自己的章节名，这里只拿来当标题，不另造一个测量值。 尺寸 φ60、φ70、φ80。每个尺寸都列出白色或黑色、上部或下部。本文只写 φ70。单位：个。球头材料牌号和寿命是缺字段。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 φ70 摆缸密封是另一页上的套件。订球头不包含那套密封。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: The source page divides this subject at “Structure”. The words under that heading, in this note, stay inside the Xingtai wording already printed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write swing-arm ball, φ70, white or black, upper or lower, and the quantity in pieces. The φ70 swing-arm ball is a wear piece for the arm that drives the S-tube, supplied from Xingtai. Colour and position are printed. A material grade is not printed. No published pump is assigned to φ70. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
